rationale: The workflow is a scheduled Android nightly build with a single job that has no explicit timeout. Pattern P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (bound jobs with a custom timeout) is supported by a measured experiment (26.8% elapsed savings) and literature-reported estimated VM-time reduction. Repository CI history shows representative successful runs of roughly 3-5 minutes, satisfying the precondition that successful-duration history exists. Adding a generous timeout-minutes: 60 bounds runaway consumption without affecting normal successful runs, preserves every build step and artifact/upload behavior, keeps permissions unchanged (contents: write), and adds no secrets, publishing/deployment, or new network access. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE was considered but is contraindicated because actions/setup-java already enables cache: gradle, i.e. an equivalent dependency cache already exists.
